recipes.name: Sweetened Condensed Milk Iced Coffee
ingredients: ¼ cup sweetened condensed coconut milk
instructions: In a cup or glass, mix together the freshly brewed espresso with the condensed coconut milk. Stir together while the espresso is hot, so the condensed milk fully dissolves.
Divide the ice cubes and espresso mix between the glasses.
Top each drink with the oat milk, give it a stir, and enjoy!
